findings.title: NaN or infinity in weights
findings.explanation: A tensor contains NaN or infinity instead of ordinary numeric values.
findings.why_it_matters: This can break inference and may indicate corruption or an intentional modification.
findings.recommendation: Quarantine and compare with a trusted checkpoint.

findings.title: Extreme weight magnitude
findings.detail: layer_0: max absolute value 250 exceeds threshold 100.
findings.explanation: At least one weight is much larger than this scanner’s conservative threshold.
findings.why_it_matters: Very large weights can destabilize a model, but some legitimate models may also contain large values.
findings.recommendation: Compare tensor statistics against an authenticated baseline.

risk.summary: Several or serious indicators were found. Hold the artifact while you investigate it.
risk.interpretation: Heuristic risk indicator; not a probability and does not prove poisoning.
risk.scoring: LOW=5, MEDIUM=18, HIGH=35, CRITICAL=50 points per finding; points are added and capped at 100. Unknown and pickle formats receive 15 additional points.

scope.behavioral_testing: Not run: requires an explicitly configured sandboxed inference adapter.
limitations: Anomalies are indicators, not proof of a backdoor.
The scanner does not execute model code or unpickle files.
Distribution thresholds may flag legitimate models.
